title: Phoneme decoding from listening MEG
scientific_question: Can MEG phoneme classification generalize to held-out narrative recordings within the original LibriBrain2025 participant under a frozen recording split?
primary_outputs: Phoneme probabilities on organizer-defined event windows.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

allowed_inputs.proposed_scope: Expected source-specific input: listening MEG plus phoneme/transcript annotations from one frozen LibriBrain edition; exact event schema/participant mapping pending.
allowed_inputs.allowed_context_policy: Only target-permitted variables may enter the query; all this task targets, future variables, answer-bearing filenames and evaluation labels stay private. Encoding receives stimuli/history with training neural responses and hides query neural targets.

biological_unit: Original 2025 phoneme build: one participant, with recording/story blocks as uncertainty units; phonemes are not independent people.
case_definition: Proposed biological-unit/session packet with nested scored observations; exact eligible cases unknown until source audit.

split.policy: Initial contract: within the original 2025 participant, hold out complete narrative recordings under a pinned manifest. Group repeated passages and overlapping story/chapter families across recordings before fixing train/development/evaluation membership, and apply temporal guards covering the complete signal-window, filtering and feature-context support. Fit normalization and select models on permitted training/development recordings only. Freeze the native-versus-adapted split distinction if story grouping changes organizer membership. Report recording/story-block uncertainty; no cross-person generalization claim. Verify actual narrative overlap before calling this unseen-story transfer.
split.uncertainty: Group at biological unit, with source-specific stimulus/block dependence; do not promote neuron/trial counts to independent animals.

reference.role: Pinned2025 phoneme experiment and current PNPL loaders. The2026 word competition is a different task; Broad reduced paths and mutable manifests need an adapter. No reference has run for this contract.

controls: Transcript/acoustic timing priors, with their access and pretrained-text exposure declared.
No phoneme target labels or target-derived event fields in the query.
Whole-recording partitions with repeated-passage/story-family grouping and signal/context guard bands.
Within-person recording/story-block uncertainty; the original 2025 participant supplies no across-person replication.

common_policy.fixed_program: Freeze program and fitting/adaptation recipe before query access; any target-batch adaptation must be explicitly permitted.
common_policy.case_adaptive: Same allowed data, checkpoint tools, context batch and accounted compute; no evaluator labels/feedback; reset case state as specified.
common_policy.model_tools: Compare generic numerical tools, supplied decoder alone, and matched agent-plus-decoder arms. Record checkpoint training exposure and preparation cost.
common_policy.investigation: Require estimand, numeric artifacts, uncertainty, alternative explanations and executable evidence; independent scorer verifies them.

observable_endpoints.definition: Fixed 39-class macro-F1 with opaque-ID joins, finite probability checks and a declared absent-class policy; retain source accuracy separately. Do not inherit 2026 top-10 balanced accuracy for 50 words.

evaluation.comparability: Distinct assignment within a shared task family/source; no new dataset/cohort claimed for paradigms, modalities or file versions.

unresolved_grading.requirement: Freeze exact sample eligibility, target definition, primary metric, split, access rules and resource budget before outcomes.

resources.basis: Unmeasured estimate. Use bounded existing derivatives/reference features; full-source procurement and model training are not implied.

holds.requirement: Select 2025 versus 2026 release/track and freeze its label schema, metric and accessible split; submissions being closed is irrelevant to local development.

Original 2025 single-subject data and 2026 expansion counted once. Expansion has over 100 hours across 33 people, heavily imbalanced toward one person; public data are not contamination-free. Source audit only; not execution-qualified.
Retrieve bounded versioned manifests/schema and verify actual recording inputs, labels, alignment and biological identity; catalog identity alone is insufficient.
Pin exact official code revision/entrypoint and license, inspect loader-to-data compatibility, and select a meaningful signal-derived reference.
Audit data, stimulus, code and checkpoint access/redistribution terms before packet distribution.
Freeze exact sample eligibility, target definition, primary metric, split, access rules and resource budget before outcomes.
Implement and run data adapter/evaluator/reference, matched controls and malformed-output tests; independently reproduce results before any validation claim.
